label: EXPERIMENTAL
disclaimer: EXPERIMENTAL: these results depend only on the parameters in this scenario. They are not game balance, not a recommendation, and not PRODUCTION_READY.
notes: EXPERIMENTAL long fight. POW minus DEF, shields, and a small heal. Not a recommended balance.

fixedRules.start: highest team SPD, compared from the supplied teamSpd aggregation
fixedRules.outcome: engine evaluateOutcome using the supplied defeat predicate

evaluatorDefinitions.formulaClamp: minimum is applied first, then maximum when maximum is not null
evaluatorDefinitions.zeroAmountConsumes: parameters.damage.incoming.zeroAmountConsumes decides whether a 0 amount clears mitigateNext
evaluatorDefinitions.rng: mulberry32. Consumption order: seeded SPD tie-break (only when the team totals are equal), side A shuffle when order is seededShuffle, side B shuffle, reshuffles in time order, then a seeded simultaneous resolution if that rule runs
evaluatorDefinitions.fingerprintExcludes: turnIndex, roundIndex, and the play log are excluded so a recurring position can be detected
evaluatorDefinitions.dominanceDenominator: wins divided by battles in that cell, including unresolved battles. Cells have equal weight. Mirror pairings are included. The observation is per seat because the starting seat can differ
evaluatorDefinitions.maxSpendableAp: largest AP from which an in-deck card can still be paid during one turn. Only skills whose grantsAp exceeds their own cost are helpers. The target card occupies a hand slot. The engine assigns base AP at turn start, so grants do not carry to the next turn
evaluatorDefinitions.healSkipsDefeatedUnlessRevive: ally heals and buffs include defeated avatars only when hp.revive is true. Damage selections never include them
evaluatorDefinitions.drawLossSetsHpZero: loseOnEmptyDraw and loseOnOverflow set that side's experimental HP to 0 so the supplied defeat predicate can run. This is not a second victory type
evaluatorDefinitions.shieldExpiry: expireAtStartOfOwnerNextTurn clears shield after the draw and before plays on the owner's later turns, so the shield is present during the opponent's intervening turn
evaluatorDefinitions.multiTarget: every target selected at the start of an effect is resolved, then the outcome is evaluated once
evaluatorDefinitions.actorStatRead: the actor selector reads parameters.targeting.actorStatRead and does not follow the damage formula's statRead on its own
evaluatorDefinitions.teamSpdReadsBase: team SPD aggregation reads stats.spd only and ignores marker bonuses
evaluatorDefinitions.playThenResolve: the engine play spends AP and does not apply an effect. The laboratory then calls resolveEffect with the compiled damage or skill rule

static.maxSpendableNote: Maximum AP from which some in-deck card can still be paid in one turn under the supplied costs, grants, and action limit. Grants do not carry across turns.

fixedRules.start: highest team SPD, compared from the supplied teamSpd aggregation
fixedRules.outcome: engine evaluateOutcome using the supplied defeat predicate
